title: Contact and Drop
author: A. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Wendell Joubert, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
